headline: Structure prediction and curated data are applied to peptide and NRP annotation and design
label: Computational Peptide Discovery Tools
summary: New tools and a v4 database link predicted structure and condition-resolved bioactivity to peptide and natural-product candidate discovery.
synthesis: The items share a tooling orientation toward peptides and peptide-like natural products, not a single method. DBAASP V4 curates peptides and peptidomimetics with condition-resolved antimicrobial, antibiofilm, anticancer and cytotoxicity data to support data-driven discovery. Peptorama draws non-ribosomal peptide structures and compares known and BGC-predicted NRPs at the peptide level, with reduced runtimes relative to BGC-level comparison. The ketoamide-forming splicease study pairs AlphaFold3 with Rosetta to rank millions of HypX and PlpX variants and map substrate scope. The leech salivary-EV work uses ESMFold with Foldseek/TM-align to assign a Ly-6/uPAR three-finger fold and flags a structurally dark fraction; it is a single-cargo annotation rather than a platform. The common thread is connecting predicted structure, curated bioactivity and genome-derived candidates.
